name: deepx_rapid_batch_dispatch
description: AnyAI Native Rapid Scene Dispatch Engine: Takes a multi-scene storyboard or image prompt collection (separated by empty line gaps) and pastes each prompt directly into Google Flow back-to-back at sub-second speed (<1s per prompt) for parallel cluster rendering with 100% fidelity to user prompts. Only runs auto_breakdown if unsegmented raw text is provided without scene gaps. FAST-PATH: Use directly without waiting or asking alignment questions. Supports both Video (Veo Omni, Veo 3.1) and Image (🍌 Nano Banana 2.1, Imagen 3).

auto_breakdown.description: If true, automatically analyzes unstructured raw text without gaps to segment scenes while preserving user content. If gaps or scenes already exist, user prompts are preserved verbatim.

count.description: Image count per prompt (1, 2, or 4). Ignored for videos.

duration.description: Duration for video scenes in seconds (5, 8, or 10). Ignored for images.

model.description: Model name. Video: 'veo-omni', 'veo-quality', 'veo-lite'. Image: '🍌 Nano Banana 2.1', '🍌 Nano Banana 2', '🍌 Nano Banana Pro', 'imagen-3'.

pacing_delay_sec.description: Pacing delay between pasting prompts into Google Flow (default: 1.5s).

script_text.description: Storyboard or prompt collection with each item separated by an empty line (gap), strictly preserved and pasted into Google Flow.
